name: kairn
description: A local knowledge graph with full-text recall, started by the client over stdio, with no LLM call needed to save or recall.

interface.shortDescription: Local knowledge graph memory with full-text recall.
interface.longDescription: Recall project knowledge before acting and save decisions and fixes to a local store in ~/.kairn. The client starts Kairn over stdio; saving and recalling need no LLM call.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recall what is known about this project before making a decision.
